summary.en: US futures pared losses as Treasury yields moderated following reports that the Treasury could use its General Account for bond buybacks. Markets await Iran sanctions details, with WTI oil dropping to $85.65 amid geopolitical uncertainty.
summary.zh: 美国期货平盘，因美债收益随着财政部或可使用一般账户回购债券的报道而缓和。市场等待伊朗制裁细节，WTI 原油因地缘政治不确定性跌至 85.65 美元。

title.en: Treasury TGA Buyback Plan Could Help Fund Bond Operations Amid Yields
title.zh: 美债 TGA 回购计划可能协助为债券操作融资，尽管收益率仍高企

impact.en: Potential relief for bond markets if Treasury announces TGA-funded buybacks, though amounts remain unspecified. Could help ease supply pressures on yields.
impact.zh: 若美债宣布使用 TGA 资金回购债券，债券市场可能缓解，尽管金额未定。或有助于减轻收益率供应压力。

macroRisk.en: No - Yield relief is structural policy, not geopolitical. Could support risk assets.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 收益率缓解是结构性政策，非地缘政治。或支持风险资产。

title.en: Oil Prices Dip to $85.65 as Iran Sanctions Drama Builds
title.zh: 油价跌至 85.65 美元，伊朗制裁戏剧升级

impact.en: WTI down 1.62%, Brent at $93.09 as markets await Trump administration's 'toughest sanctions' announcement against Iran Sept 8 retaliation date looms.
impact.zh: WTI 下跌 1.62%，布伦特原油在 93.09 美元，市场等待特朗普政府宣布对伊朗的‘最严厉制裁’，加拿大报复措施于 9 月 8 日生效。

macroRisk.en: Medium - Iran tension creates volatility but may not sustain rally if sanctions prove effective. Watch for OPEC response.
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 伊朗紧张局势造成波动，但若制裁有效则难以维持涨势。关注 OPEC 反应。

title.en: NVIDIA Warns of 15% AI Server Price Hikes Due to Memory Costs
title.zh: 英伟达警告因内存成本上涨，AI 服务器价格将提高 15%

impact.en: Memory supply constraints squeezing margins. NVIDIA also exploring $30B deal to fund Perplexity AI, which saw revenue explode to $750M.
impact.zh: 内存供应约束挤压利润率。英伟达也在探索 300 亿美元协议以资助 Perplexity AI，其收入激增到 7.5 亿美元。

macroRisk.en: Low - Supply-chain issue within AI sector, not macro regime change.
macroRisk.zh: 低 - 是 AI 行业内的供应链问题，非宏观体制变化。

title.en: Hugging Face Explored $13B Sale Amid Security Concerns
title.zh: 因安全担忧，Hugging Face 被考虑以 130 亿美元出售

impact.en: OpenAI breach partner seeks exit. M&A activity in AI infrastructure could reshape the landscape as consolidation accelerates.
impact.zh: OpenAI 泄密合作伙伴寻求退出。AI 基础设施的并购活动可能重塑格局，随着整合加速。

macroRisk.en: Low - Corporate-level M&A, not macro policy signal.
macroRisk.zh: 低 - 企业级并购，非宏观政策信号。

title.en: Canada Confirms Retaliatory Tariffs Effective Sept 8
title.zh: 加拿大确认报复性关税于 9 月 8 日生效

impact.en: Trade negotiations collapsed. Canada will impose counter-tariffs on US goods, potential inflationary pressure on cross-border trade.
impact.zh: 贸易谈判破裂。加拿大将对美国商品实施报复性关税，可能对跨境贸易造成通胀压力。

macroRisk.en: Medium - Trade escalation could affect energy, agriculture sectors. Watch for broader tariff spillover.
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 贸易升级可能影响能源、农业部门。留意更广泛关税外溢效应。

title.en: Bitcoin and Gold Surge on Treasury Buyback Backfire
title.zh: 比特币和黄金因美债回购受挫而飙升

impact.en: Yields stayed elevated despite doubled buyback limit, boosting hard assets. Stablecoin bank Fastet reached $1B valuation.
impact.zh: 尽管加倍了回购额度，收益率仍维持高位，利好硬资产。稳定币银行 Fastet 估值达到 10 亿美元。

macroRisk.en: Medium - Inflation hedge demand rising amid fiscal uncertainty.
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 财政不确定性推高通胀对冲需求。

title.en: Morgan Stanley: Quality Stocks Make S&P 500 More Attractive Than Overseas
title.zh: 摩根士丹利：优质股票使标普 500 比海外更具吸引力

impact.en: US equities outperform global peers despite geopolitics. Quality factor gains support defensive positioning.
impact.zh: 尽管地缘政治，美股仍跑赢全球同行。质量因子收益支持防御性配置。

macroRisk.en: Low - Relative valuation appeal, not macro catalyst.
macroRisk.zh: 低 - 相对估值吸引力，非宏观催化剂。

ai.en: Mixed signals: NVIDIA's $30B Perplexity deal and $750M revenue for AI partners suggest demand persists, but memory cost warnings temper enthusiasm. Hugging Face sale talks hint at sector consolidation.
ai.zh: 信号混杂：NVIDIA 的 300 亿美元 Perplexity 协议和 AI 合作伙伴的 7.5 亿美元收入表明需求持续，但内存成本警告抑制热情。Hugging Face 出售谈判暗示行业整合。

semiconductor.en: Memory supply constraints and NVIDIA's 15% price hike warnings create near-term headwinds. Chip stocks trading flat as AI infrastructure investment pace moderates.
semiconductor.zh: 内存供应约束和英伟达的 15% 涨价警告造成短期阻力。芯片股票交投平淡，AI 基础设施投资速度放缓。

bigTech.en: Relatively stable with Hugging Face seeking $13B exit. Consolidation likely accelerates as AI infrastructure M&A continues. US quality factor premium persists.
bigTech.zh: 相对稳定，Hugging Face 寻求 130 亿美元退出。随着 AI 基础设施并购继续，整合可能加速。美国质量因子溢价持续。

energy.en: Oil volatility tied to Iran sanctions narrative. WTI at $85.65, Brent at $93.09 as geopolitical premium fades if sanctions work. Energy sector faces cross-border trade impact from Canada tariffs.
energy.zh: 油价波动与伊朗制裁叙事相关。WTI 在 85.65 美元，布伦特在 93.09 美元，地缘溢价在制裁有效时消退。能源部门面临加拿大关税对跨境贸易的影响。

ev.en: Auto sector broadly flat, with EV makers feeling mixed pressure from trade escalation and oil price volatility. Supply chain diversification remains priority.
ev.zh: 汽车板块总体平稳，电动车制造商受到贸易升级和油价波动带来的混合压力。供应链多元化仍是优先事项。

market.en: Futures pared losses: SPX -0.18%, NASD -0.54%, DJIA -0.12%. Market awaiting clarity on Treasury policy and Iran sanctions, with risk appetite moderate amid fiscal uncertainty.
market.zh: 期货平盘：SPX 下跌 0.18%，纳指下跌 0.54%，道指下跌 0.12%。市场等待美债政策和伊朗制裁的明确信号，财政不确定性下风险偏好温和。

preciousMetals.en: Gold surged as Treasury yield relief strategy backfired, with Bitcoin and precious metals gaining hard asset appeal despite elevated yields. Inflation hedge demand rising.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金因美债收益率缓解策略受挫而飙升，比特币和贵金属尽管收益率高企仍获得硬资产吸引力。通胀对冲需求上升。

oil.en: WTI down 1.62% to $85.65, Brent at $93.09 as markets digest Iran sanctions drama. Watch for OPEC response and whether Washington's pressure on Tehran can isolate economy.
oil.zh: WTI 下跌 1.62% 至 85.65 美元，布伦特在 93.09 美元，市场消化伊朗制裁戏剧。关注 OPEC 回应和华盛顿能否通过施压孤立德黑兰经济。

futures.en: Slightly lower: SPX -0.18%, NASD -0.54%, DJIA -0.12% as investors assess Treasury policy and Iran sanctions impact on risk assets.
futures.zh: 略微下跌：SPX 下跌 0.18%，纳指下跌 0.54%，道指下跌 0.12%，投资者评估美债政策和伊朗制裁对风险资产的影响。

treasury10Y.en: Moderated from previous week's spike as reports emerged that Treasury could use TGA for bond buybacks, though amounts remain unspecified.
treasury10Y.zh: 随着报道出现财政部可使用 TGA 回购债券而从前一周的峰值回落，尽管金额未定。

dxy.en: Under pressure from Bessent's hints toward weaker dollar policy. Treasury Secretary's devaluation bets reignited as he suggests policy shifts.
dxy.zh: 受到贝森特对弱势美元政策的暗示而承压。财政部长的贬值赌注因他建议政策转变而被重燃。

oil.en: WTI at $85.65, Brent at $93.09 as geopolitical premium fades. Watch for OPEC response and supply chain disruptions in Hormuz Strait closure aftermath.
oil.zh: WTI 在 85.65 美元，布伦特在 93.09 美元，地缘溢价消退。关注 OPEC 回应和霍尔木兹海峡关闭后的供应链中断。

keyRisk.en: Iran sanctions announcement later today could trigger volatility. Secondary risk: Canada's Sept 8 tariff retaliation affecting energy/agriculture sectors.
keyRisk.zh: 今天稍后宣布的伊朗制裁可能触发波动。次要风险：加拿大 9 月 8 日的关税报复影响能源/农业部门。

note.en: Mixed sentiment: Treasury yield moderation supports risk assets temporarily, but geopolitical Iran sanctions and trade escalation create uncertainty. Gold/BTC hedge demand offsets equity pressure in precious metals sector.
note.zh: 混合情绪：美债收益率缓和暂时支持风险资产，但伊朗制裁和贸易升级造成不确定性。黄金/比特币对冲需求抵消贵金属部门的股票压力。
